home.metaTitle: Apartamento Mar Azul · A quiet apartment in Lagos for couples and small families
home.metaDescription: A quiet apartment in Lagos, Algarve. Walking distance from the centre and the beaches. Sleeps 2 to 4. Private terrace, A/C, Wi-Fi, free parking. From €{priceFrom} per night.

about.title: Walking distance from the centre and the beaches.
about.body: The apartment sits on a quiet residential street. Walk down to the city centre for breakfast, cut through the centre for a dive in the sea, and follow the coast path to Ponta da Piedade before the morning crowds arrive.

perks.title: Booking direct gets you a few extra things.

items: Late check-out and early check-in when the calendar allows.
Direct WhatsApp line with Stefania, before and during your stay.
A short walking guide of the host's favourite tasca, padaria, and quiet beach.
